subject: reasoning
question: Directions: If all books" are "papers," and some "papers" are notes, " which of the following must be TRUE?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

All books are papers.

Some papers are notes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b607b0a29dc1166af720c5120fa79d7a6723968cdbe40ba26ab020f79510001.png] 

**Option (1)**: All books are notes. ⇒ **False **(While all books are inside the "papers" circle, the "notes" circle only overlaps with some part of "papers." There is no information that forces the "notes" circle to cover all "books.")
